summary: Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine interest payment on its Seventh Issuance of Notes in the Colombian peso market. No special situation such as a merger, acquisition, spin-off, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of a contractual payment. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic actions to analyze. This is not a special situation event.
